subject: Demo scheduling: need exec sponsor coverage
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-05T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Demo: Redwood walkthrough — proposed windows

Hi Jordan —

Quick follow on our call last week. The ACME team asked for an exec-level presence (CTO or VP) for the product walkthrough so we can cover architecture, SLAs, and rollout options. Per your note that the CTO would like to be present, I pulled two windows that should be conference-friendly for your team next week:

- Tue 2027-09-12, 08:30–09:15 PT (exec brief + Q&A)
- Wed 2027-09-13, 11:00–12:00 PT (deep technical demo with hands-on Q&A)

If the CTO can only make one, we can compress the exec-level items into the Tue slot and record the technical session for the CTO to watch, followed by a shorter sync.

Attached: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v2.pdf with proposed attendees and next steps.

Can you confirm whether the CTO or VP is likely to join one of these windows? If neither works, please share a couple of preferred times and we’ll re-propose.

Thanks,
Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v2.pdf (47KB)
From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-05T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood walkthrough — proposed windows

Thanks, Soojin.

Quick update: the CTO (Mark Rivera) is scheduling travel next week and is in transit Tue morning through Wed midday — looks like both of your proposed windows overlap with his flights. He flagged that he really wants to see the exec summary live (high-level latency/cost tradeoffs + SLA behaviour under our predicted load).

Two asks:
1) Can you propose an earlier morning slot (e.g., 07:30–08:00 PT) on Tue so Mark can join before heading to the airport?
2) If not possible, would your VP-level rep be able to cover the exec portion? Linda Chang (our VP Product) is sometimes available and might join.

Also, procurement will want a short follow-up technical Q&A — can we ensure an engineer is on the Wed technical deep-dive or as a separate 30-min post-demo?

Jordan
Director, Platform Engineering | Acme Corp
jordan.smith@acme.com | +1 212-555-0147
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-05T11:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood walkthrough — proposed windows

Jordan — thanks for flagging Mark's travel. Two quick options that keep exec coverage intact: 

Option A (preferred):
- Tue 2027-09-12, 07:30–08:00 PT — 25-minute exec-focused briefing (Soojin + VP-level overview)
- Wed 2027-09-13, 11:00–12:00 PT — full technical hands-on session (engineer-led)

Option B (if early Tue is impossible):
- Tue 2027-09-12, 08:30–09:00 PT — exec brief led by our VP (Vanessa Ortiz) while Mark is en route; we record and provide a private recording immediately after.
- Wed 2027-09-13, 11:00–12:00 PT — technical deep-dive with engineer present

Vanessa (cc) can confirm VP availability for Option B. Karthik will lead the technical session on Wed if that works. I’ve attached a short exec agenda (agenda-exec-brief.odp) and updated MAP with the recommended timeline.

If you can confirm which option is best today, I’ll send updated calendar invites and a short pre-read for Mark/Linda.

Best,
Soojin

Attachment: agenda-exec-brief.odp (120KB)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-05T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood walkthrough — proposed windows

Hi Jordan — I can cover the exec brief if Mark is traveling. I’m available for Option B (Tue 08:30–09:00 PT) and can compress the key SLA and deployment slides to 20 minutes so we leave time for quick Qs.

If Mark can take an early call, Option A is great too — Linda Chang (your VP) is also welcome if she prefers an earlier time; please loop her in or confirm.

Also happy to host the technical follow-up on Wed with Karthik — Karthik, can you confirm you’ll lead the 11:00 session and have an engineer available for the procurement Q&A?

Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0033
